Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title states the main behavior change: a list refused by the evals check goes back to the writer, including on a rerun, and a stop holds the list. The raw summary and PR objectives confirm the change centers on refused eval lists being sent back to the writer for up to evalsRounds attempts, and on stop results preserving the list or record. The title is long and uses the parenthetical '(RE)' tag, which adds noise, but it still describes the primary change accurately.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#792` requires a runtime fix. In the land-fix branch of runPRSteps, the local history and lateMinors arrays must move to per-PR state maps. The runPR catch result must spread them for a land fix, so a throwing bot-answer call keeps the minor from landFixCheck. The PR description and the PR objectives say the PR changes only SKILL.md for this issue. The RE-13 case asserts that a land-fix run that throws carries its minors under lateMinors. The PR summary of workflows/run-wave.js describes evals writer and refused-list changes only. It names no land-fix state map and no catch change. The reviewed head therefore lacks the coding requirement. The SKILL.md text now describes behavior that the code does not provide. I could not read the runPR catch block, because the workflows/run-wave.js file read is truncated at 16000 bytes. The diff read for that file failed, so the absence rests on the PR summary and description, not on the full source. **Resolution** Implement the `#792` requirement in workflows/run-wave.js. In the land-fix branch of runPRSteps, store the local history and lateMinors in per-PR state maps, as the non-land-fix path does. In the runPR catch, spread those values into the result for a land-fix input. Add a sim test that makes the bot-answer call throw twice after landFixCheck returns a minor, and assert that the result keeps lateMinors and history. Keep the RE-13 SKILL.md wording only after the runtime behavior holds.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The PR changes the evals writer loop, the rerun writer prompt, the evals-stop result fields, the resume path, SKILL.md, and test/sim-pipeline.mjs cases RE-1 to RE-15. The PR description and the PR objectives present these as the PR's declared purpose. None of them connects to the coding requirements of `#792`, which covers only the land-fix catch result. So the evals work has no concrete link to the linked issue. The PR description, however, names the evals work as its own intent, and the linked issue list does not name it. Whether this work belongs in this PR is a scope decision that the available evidence does not settle. The related files, the test runs, and the check-syntax run are reported by the author but not verified in this review. **Resolution** Confirm the scope decision. Either link an issue that requires the evals writer loop and the rerun prompt changes, or split the evals work into its own PR. The land-fix change for `#792` is needed in any case, as stated in the linkedIssuesAssessment resolution. After the scope is settled, rerun this assessment on the reviewed head.
